figurative_meaning_bn: ফোজদারী মামলাসম্পর্কে থানায় প্রদত্ত বিবৃতি বা লিখিত অভিযোগ; স্বাক্ষীর উক্তি
figurative_meaning_en: A statement or written complaint provided at the police station regarding a criminal case; a witness's testimony
similar_in_english: give a statement to the police
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুলিশ একে একে সবার এজাহার নেবে।
ভুক্তভোগী তার এজাহারে ঘটনার বিবরণ দিলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: The police will take statements from everyone one by one.
The victim gave a detailed account of the incident in his statement.
history: Derived from Arabic 'izhar' meaning declaration, adopted into Bengali legal lexicon during British colonial period via Urdu influence in police procedures.
note: This is primarily a legal term used in formal contexts rather than a traditional figurative idiom.
